name: What is the process for hiring a general contractor for a bathroom remodel?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for hiring a general contractor for a bathroom remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process for hiring a general contractor involves several steps. Start by researching local contractors with experience in small bathroom remodels and good reviews. Request quotes from at least three contractors, ensuring they provide detailed estimates of costs and timelines. Verify their licenses, insurance, and references. Finally, review the contract thoroughly, clarifying all terms and conditions, before making your selection.
acceptedAnswer.description: To hire a general contractor, research local options, get detailed quotes, verify licenses/insurance, check references, and review the contract.
